truths.text: What is a small thing that always makes you happy?

dares.text: Speak in a cartoon voice until your next turn.
Give a 10-second speech praising the person to your left.
Sing the first line of any song.
Do your best kind impression of a family member.
Tell a joke, even a bad one.
Dance for 15 seconds with no music.
Say the alphabet backward from Z to A.
Make up a new nickname for yourself and explain it.
Do five slow-motion high-fives with the room.
Describe your day using only three emojis.
Balance a spoon on your nose for five seconds.
Give a dramatic thank-you speech to your phone.
Do a runway walk across the room.
Invent a new snack and pitch it in one sentence.
Say momos in five different emotions.
Draw a self-portrait with your eyes closed.
Compliment every player in one breath.
Do your best animal impression.
Pretend to be a news anchor reading the room's latest headline.
Make a funny face and hold it for five seconds.
